title: Paseo worktree setup
description: Adds paseo.json, whose setup readies each new Paseo worktree: it copies the gitignored personal files (.env files, mise.local.toml, .claude/settings.local.json) from the source checkout without overwriting tracked ones, then trusts and installs the mise toolchain. Stack templates append their own install steps after it.

content: "cd \"$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH\" && for f in .env .env.* mise.local.toml .claude/settings.local.json; do [ ! -f \"$f\" ] || [ -e \"$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH/$f\" ] || { mkdir -p \"$(dirname \"$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH/$f\")\" && cp -p \"$f\" \"$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH/$f\"; } || exit 1; done",
